name: Qadir, son of the eldest Qadir

arn.text: Qadir, the son of the eldest Qadir, becomes the new Qadir and appoints Mishra his raki, after which the mak fawa kills the Thaladin ambush and the tribe submits, leaving the Suwwardi to reign over the Fallaji.

At the Peace Summit at Korlinda he first calls the Fallaji an empire, but the summit collapses when he stabs the Yotian Warlord, and Urza's automaton chokes him until Mishra's Weakstone overloads the automaton.
Ashnod drains his life with the Staff of Zegon, killing him, and Mishra becomes the last Qadir.
